morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。常规书写首字母大写；所列音标为常见英语读法，法语读法为 /lwiz/。

senses.zh_definition: 路易丝；源于法语的女性名字，在马来语文本中作为专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: Louise, a feminine given name of French origin, used as a proper noun.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang berasal daripada bahasa Perancis.
senses.nuances: 属于人名，不是具有普通词汇义的马来语通名。输入包未提供 DBP 释义，因此此处马来语定义为编写说明；status 沿用指定记录标签，不代表 DBP 已将其核定为普通词条。姓名来源及读音参见：[Behind the Name：Louise](https://www.behindthename.com/name/louise)。以下为称谓组合，不代表经语料统计确认的高频搭配。

dual_scenarios.ms: Puan Louise akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: Louise 女士将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Ms Louise will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Louise dah sampai kat lobi ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Louise sudah sampai di lobi?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Louise arrived in the lobby yet?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式
kat 在此对应地点介词 di
句末 ke 构成口语疑问句
nak 是 hendak 的口语形式

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Louise dah sampai kat lobi ke? Aku nak turun sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Louise sudah sampai di lobi? Saya hendak turun sekarang.
messages.zh: Louise 到大堂了吗？我现在准备下楼。
messages.en: Is Louise in the lobby yet? I'm about to head downstairs.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat depan lif. Turunlah.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah sampai dan sedang menunggu di hadapan lif. Silakan turun.
messages.zh: 到了，她在电梯前面等着。下来吧。
messages.en: Yes, she's waiting by the lifts. Come on down.

etymology.historical_story: Louise is the French feminine form of Louis. Louis continues a Germanic naming tradition through Latinized forms, with older elements associated with fame and battle. These historical associations explain the name's ancestry; they are not its everyday dictionary meaning. In Malay discourse, Louise simply identifies a person bearing that name.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Louise 联想到中文名“路易丝”；英语结尾读 /z/。记住具体的人，比硬拆马来语词根更有效。
